message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. Two men, shown from the chest up, face each other in the foreground against a background of fire and a distant stone structure. Both wear white shirts, dark fingerless gloves, and grey helmets with flip-up visors. The man on the left has a tan backpack with a unicorn emblem and a black belt with a pouch. The man on the right wears black pants. Each carries a long-barreled firearm over his shoulder. 

Between them, orange and yellow explosions rise. In the distance sits a multi-tiered, dome-topped stone structure under a blue sky with white and grey clouds. Large white letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Smaller text reads "JUDI DUNIA DI SEPAK BOLA KITA," "DALAM SERBUAN SEMEN CINA," and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Central orange and yellow text reads "PERANG BUBAT DI TANAH JAWA." The bottom left contains a barcode and text including "25 FEBRUARI-3 MARET 2019," "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." A thick red vertical stripe borders the left edge.
